buildings.description:
Operating Hours:
Mondays - Thursdays
7:00 am - 6:00 pm 

The Cavite State University Health Services (CvSU Health Services). This central facility embodies the university's commitment to student well-being by offering a comprehensive range of health services. True to its mission, CvSU Health Services prioritizes preventative, promotive, and curative care for its target clientele – students, faculty, and staff. The dedicated staff provides quality, affordable, and easily accessible healthcare, ensuring a healthy and supportive environment for the entire university community.

buildings.name: Ladislao N. Diwa Memorial Library
buildings.description: Welcome to the Ladislao N. Diwa Memorial Library and Museum (LDMLM)—a symbol of knowledge and heritage since 1980. With a collection of over 106,000 volumes and 5,000 series titles, LDMLM honors Ladislao N. Diwa's contributions to academia. Operating under an open shelf system, our mission is to provide excellent, equitable, and relevant library services. We aim to support academic excellence, encourage maximum utilization of resources, and collaborate with all colleges and campuses to supplement research and instruction. Step inside and discover a world of knowledge and inspiration.

buildings.name: Administration Building
buildings.description: Welcome to the Cavite State University Administration Building at our University.

buildings.name: Office of Student Affairs and Services
buildings.description: Welcome to the Office of Student Affairs and Services at Cavite State University — A cornerstone of student support and development. Established in 1980, our office has evolved to meet the diverse needs of our students. From counseling and testing to financial assistance and talent development, we're here to empower students to reach their full potential. Whether it's guidance, training, or placement services, we're committed to fostering an environment where every student can thrive intellectually, emotionally, and socially.

buildings.name: College of Engineering and Information Technology
buildings.description: The College of Engineering and Information Technology (CEIT) fosters a dynamic scholarly community dedicated to advancing the frontiers of engineering innovation. CEIT faculty address global challenges through research and curriculum focused on areas such as resilient infrastructure and sustainable transportation systems. By joining CEIT, you will contribute to shaping a brighter future.

buildings.name: College of Nursing
buildings.description: Welcome to the College of Nursing, where we embrace the profound impact of early nurturing and education on lifelong health and well-being. Within our supportive and inclusive community, dedicated mentors guide you to excel in the intricate field of nursing, equipping you with the knowledge and skills to make a tangible difference in the lives of individuals and families. Through innovative research and immersive practical experiences, we empower you to navigate the complexities of healthcare and emerge as compassionate, competent caregivers. Join us in a journey where learning knows no bounds, and excellence is the standard.

buildings.name: College of Arts and Sciences
buildings.description: The College of Arts and Sciences at this university welcomes you to its energetic community. Here, scholars explore the vast spectrum of human creativity and knowledge. From the mysteries of the universe to the intricacies of human behavior, the college is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of understanding. By embracing diverse viewpoints and fostering creative exploration, they tackle the complexities of the world. The college invites you to join them at the forefront of intellectual discovery and artistic expression.

buildings.name: Department of Biological Sciences
buildings.description: Welcome to the Department of Biological Sciences at the University. Our state-of-the-art facilities and passionate community of scholars are dedicated to exploring the wonders of life. From molecular biology to ecology, we're committed to advancing our understanding of the natural world and addressing global challenges. Join us on a journey of discovery and exploration. Welcome to the heart of scientific inquiry.

buildings.name: College of Agriculture, Forestry, Environment, and Natural Resources
buildings.description: The College of Agriculture, Forestry, Environment, and Natural Resources building embodies innovation and sustainability. Its modern design integrates seamlessly with nature, featuring spacious interiors filled with natural light and cutting-edge facilities. With a focus on eco-friendly practices, including energy-efficient systems and green rooftops, the building serves as a hub for interdisciplinary learning and research. Surrounded by lush gardens and outdoor spaces, it inspires environmental stewardship and fosters collaboration among students and faculty.

buildings.name: Department of Industrial Engineering and Technology
buildings.description: Welcome to the Department of Industrial Engineering and Technology at our University. Within our dedicated community, we explore the forefront of technology and innovation. From optimizing manufacturing processes to enhancing supply chain efficiency, we're committed to solving real-world challenges and driving industry forward. Join us as we embark on a journey of discovery and innovation. Welcome to the heart of industrial engineering excellence.

buildings.name: College of Veterinary Medicine and Biomedical Sciences
buildings.description: The College of Veterinary Medicine and Biomedical Sciences at Cavite State University fosters expertise in veterinary medicine, biomedical sciences, and animal welfare. With a focus on ethical practice, professional excellence, and community service, we prepare students for impactful careers in veterinary medicine, research, and animal care. Our curriculum blends hands-on training with innovative research, empowering graduates to drive positive change in their communities. Join us in shaping a healthier, more compassionate society.

buildings.name: College of Sports, Physical Education, and Recreation
buildings.description: Introducing the College of Sports, Physical Education, and Recreation at Cavite State University, established in 1998 to promote excellence in sports across the Southern Tagalog Region. Our mission is to provide top-tier instruction in physical education and recreation sciences while fostering a culture of active living among students and the community. With a focus on leadership and collaboration, we're dedicated to shaping competent professionals and elevating the region's sporting landscape.
buildings.departments:

Physical Education

Bachelor in Sports and Recreational Management

buildings.name: College of Criminal Justice
buildings.description: The College of Criminal Justice at the University fosters a deep understanding and practical application of law enforcement, criminal justice, and public safety principles. Imbued with a commitment to ethical conduct, professional excellence, and community service, the college cultivates students for fulfilling careers in law enforcement, corrections, and security. The curriculum offers a rich tapestry of experiences, from immersive hands-on training to pioneering research endeavors. This comprehensive approach equips graduates with the necessary tools and knowledge to become instrumental agents of positive change within their communities. By joining the College of Criminal Justice, students become part of a collaborative effort to forge a safer and more equitable society.
buildings.coursesOffered:
Bachelor of Science in Criminology
Bachelor of Science in Industrial Security Administration

buildings.name: University Cashier
buildings.description: The University Cashier's Office, situated in located at the back of the Administration Building, acts as the central hub for students, faculty, and staff to manage all university-related finances. Dedicated staff provide exceptional customer service in a transparent environment. Readily addresses any questions regarding university fees and payments. This ensures a smooth and hassle-free experience when navigating financial obligations at the university.

buildings.name: Research Center
buildings.description: Introducing the Research Center Building at Cavite State University: a nexus of innovation and collaboration. Equipped with cutting-edge facilities, it fosters groundbreaking research across disciplines, especially in agriculture. Designed for knowledge dissemination and external engagement, it serves as a hub for forging partnerships, training, and recognizing outstanding achievements. A beacon of progress, it embodies the university's commitment to improving lives and advancing knowledge for the community.

buildings.name: International House 1 / College of Medicine
buildings.description: International House 1 welcomes students with open arms, serving as a vibrant home away from home for the university community. This bustling dormitory fosters a diverse and inclusive environment, where students from all walks of life connect and forge lasting friendships. International House 1 which also houses the College of Medicine, offers comfortable living spaces, modern amenities, and a supportive atmosphere that empowers residents to excel academically, socially, and personally. Here, students thrive within a community that fosters unforgettable experiences.

buildings.name: Bahay ng Alumni
buildings.description: Welcome to Bahay ng Alumni—a cozy retreat found near the Gymnasium of the University. Our inviting rooms offer a blend of comfort and nostalgia, providing guests with a home-away-from-home experience. Whether you're here for a trip down memory lane or attending an event, we promise a memorable stay filled with warmth and hospitality.

buildings.name: International Convention Center
buildings.description: The University International Convention Center serves as a multipurpose venue for significant university events and external collaborations. This impressive structure hosts formal university functions, from standardized exams and bustling job fairs to grand graduation ceremonies, with its adaptable space configurable to each event's needs. Beyond university-organized gatherings, the center can be rented by external organizations for conferences, or even social events. The University International Convention Center embodies the university's pursuit of excellence, offering a platform to celebrate student achievements and foster collaboration within the broader community.

buildings.name: Layat Diwa Statue
buildings.description: This brass artwork carries the University’s ideals of TRUTH, EXCELLENCE and SERVICE. There are five basic elements in the artwork together with the symbolic figures and meanings. The unchained female figure, holding a book, represents the empowered Filipino woman. She is beauty personified and is today’s contemporary woman – a mother, a nurturer, an educator, and a humble servant to humanity.

buildings.name: Lagoon
buildings.description: The Lagoon, a serene body of water that serves as a central feature of the university's landscape. This tranquil oasis offers a peaceful retreat from the bustling campus, inviting visitors to relax and unwind amidst the beauty of nature. The Lagoon is home to a variety of aquatic plants and animals, creating a vibrant ecosystem that provides a habitat for local wildlife. Whether you're seeking a quiet spot to read, meditate, or simply enjoy the beauty of the outdoors, the Lagoon provides a serene escape for all who visit.

buildings.name: Department of Information Technology
buildings.description: The Department of Information Technology (DIT), nestled within the College of Engineering and Information Technology (CEIT), is housed in a modern building characterized by sleek architecture and cutting-edge facilities. Its spacious atrium welcomes students and visitors, while state-of-the-art classrooms, labs, and collaborative spaces provide an ideal environment for learning and research. From interactive displays showcasing the latest advancements to dedicated research wings driving innovation, the department's building serves as a dynamic hub for aspiring technologists and researchers alike.

The Computer Laboratory is equipped with the latest hardware and software to support students in their coursework and research. From programming to networking, students have access to the tools they need to succeed.
